source_evidence.frozen_requirement_text: Open water means a large area of freely navigable water in which sea ice is present in concentrations less than 1/10. No ice of land origin is present.

contract.comparisonModel: IF ice_condition = 'open water', THEN sea_ice_concentration_tenths < 1 AND ice_of_land_origin_present = false.
